queries.sql: SELECT `a`.`schedule_id`, `e`.`batchName`, `e`.`batch_id`, `a`.`school_year`, `a`.`name`, `a`.`status`, `c`.`fullname`, `d`.`total` FROM `schedules` `a` LEFT JOIN `assignments` `b` ON `b`.`schedule_id`=`a`.`schedule_id` LEFT JOIN `accounts` `c` ON `c`.`account_id`=`b`.`account_id` LEFT JOIN (Select schedule_id,count(*)total from trainings group by schedule_id) d ON `d`.`schedule_id`=`a`.`schedule_id` LEFT JOIN `batches` `e` ON `e`.`batch_id`=`a`.`batch_id` GROUP BY `a`.`schedule_id`, `c`.`fullname`, `d`.`total`
